description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and formation of basement incorporating a front lightwell to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (20-044-P02 (Rev A)  Received:  14 December 2020;  20-044-E01; 20-044-E02; 20-044-E03; 20-044-E04; 20-044-E05; 20-044-E06; 20-044-E07; 20-044-E08; 20-044-P01; 20-044-P03; 20-044-P04; 20-044-P05; 20-044-P06; 20-044-P07; 20-044-P08; 20-044-P09  Received:  30 October 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of excavation works for the basement to the original house hereby approved, a Construction Method Statement and Structural Survey, Construction Environment Management Plan, Construction Logistics Plan and Flood Risk Assessment produced by independent qualified professionals shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  All excavation works shall be undertaken in full compliance with these approved documents.  Any necessary inspection access or evidence shall be made available to the Council to ensure effective monitoring of compliance with these approved documents as necessary.
